verdict.rationale: Avalara documents interactive API documentation and an API Explorer with sample payloads and response examples, backed by per-method reference pages such as CreateTransaction and CreateNexus. The evidence only says the Explorer is used to "review" endpoints and expected responses; it never states that examples can be executed live against the API. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that examples are runnable in-browser (try-it/sandbox execution), and hands-on or independent corroboration of the Explorer's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Get started with interactive API documentation, sample payloads, and response examples. Use API Explorer to review endpoints, parameters, authentication requirements, and expected responses
